D007-D015_h001.question:
I’ve been struggling for about seven months now—ever since I missed an important filing deadline, something I’ve never done in 20 years of law. I’ve also seen figures in my apartment late at night—people standing near the window, though the door was locked and no one was ever there.

The worst part is, even when I had a few days where my mood lifted a little, the delusions and hallucinations didn’t go away—they just kept going.
